train.repetition_definition: sum of exactly identical token-prefix lengths between adjacent turn examples; schema rerendering may shorten prefixes
train.expansion_definition: sum of all turn input lengths / sum of each trajectory final-turn input length; not a count of unique semantic tokens
train.overlength_policy: defer entire trajectory exceeding context or 4096-token target limit; no silent truncation or target-only clipping
